lessons.title: 3. Filtering Records with WHERE
lessons.description: Filter rows using WHERE, comparison operators, IN, BETWEEN, and LIKE. Query products with price greater than 100.
lessons.starter_code: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100;

tests.name: test_filter_products
tests.test_code: assert all(r[1] > 100 for r in rows)
